points.title: 早年求学
points.description: 祖冲之出生于建康（今南京）一个官宦世家，自幼受到良好的教育。他的祖父祖昌曾任大匠卿，掌管建筑工程，这使祖冲之从小接触数学和天文知识。在建康期间，他广泛研读古代典籍，特别是《周髀算经》、《九章算术》等数学著作，并开始对天文历法产生浓厚兴趣。这段时期的学习为他后来的科学研究奠定了坚实基础，培养了他严谨的治学态度和独立思考能力。
points.descriptionEn: Born into an official family in Jiankang (modern Nanjing), Zu Chongzhi received excellent education from an early age. His grandfather Zu Chang served as Dajiangqing, overseeing construction projects, which exposed Zu Chongzhi to mathematics and astronomy. During this period in Jiankang, he extensively studied ancient classics, particularly mathematical works like 'Zhou Bi Suan Jing' and 'Jiu Zhang Suan Shu', and developed a keen interest in astronomical calendars. This foundational learning established his rigorous academic approach and independent thinking abilities.

points.title: 仕途与天文观测
points.description: 461年，祖冲之被任命为南徐州从事史，开始了他的仕途生涯。在此期间，他利用职务之便，在镇江地区进行了大量天文观测，记录了日月星辰的运行规律。他发现当时通行的《元嘉历》存在误差，经过精密计算和观测，编制了更为精确的《大明历》。这一历法首次将岁差引入历法计算，大大提高了历法的准确性。同时，他还发明了多种天文观测仪器，如浑天仪、漏刻等，为天文研究提供了重要工具。
points.descriptionEn: In 461, Zu Chongzhi was appointed as an official in Southern Yangzhou (modern Zhenjiang), beginning his official career. During this period, he took advantage of his position to conduct extensive astronomical observations in the Zhenjiang area, recording the patterns of celestial bodies. He discovered errors in the then-current 'Yongjia Calendar' and, through precise calculations and observations, created the more accurate 'Daming Calendar'. This calendar was the first to incorporate the precession of the equinoxes, significantly improving calendar accuracy. He also invented various astronomical instruments such as the armillary sphere and water clock, providing important tools for astronomical research.

points.title: 数学研究高峰
points.description: 回到建康后，祖冲之进入了他数学研究的黄金时期。他深入研究《九章算术》，并在此基础上进行了创新和发展。最著名的成就是他将圆周率精确计算到小数点后第七位（3.1415926 < π < 3.1415927），这一成就领先世界近千年。他还提出了'密率'（355/113）和'约率'（22/7）两个圆周率近似值，其中'密率'在西方直到16世纪才由荷兰数学家安托尼兹重新发现。此外，他还著有《缀术》、《九章算术注》等数学著作，对中国古代数学发展产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: Returning to Jiankang, Zu Chongzhi entered the golden period of his mathematical research. He deeply studied 'Jiu Zhang Suan Shu' and made innovative developments based on it. His most famous achievement was calculating the value of pi to seven decimal places (3.1415926 < π < 3.1415927), a feat that remained ahead of the world for nearly a millennium. He also proposed two approximations for pi: the 'close rate' (355/113) and the 'approximate rate' (22/7), with the 'close rate' not being rediscovered in the West until the 16th century by the Dutch mathematician Anthonisz. Additionally, he authored mathematical works such as 'Zhui Shu' and 'Commentary on Jiu Zhang Suan Shu', which had a profound impact on the development of ancient Chinese mathematics.

points.title: 水利工程实践
points.description: 在丹阳任职期间，祖冲之将他的数学和天文学知识应用于实际工程中。他主持修建了多项水利工程，包括改进灌溉系统、修建水坝等。他运用数学计算精确测量地形和水流，设计出高效的水利设施，大大提高了农业生产效率。同时，他还研究了机械制造，发明了指南车、千里船等多种实用机械。这些工程实践不仅体现了他的科学才能，也展示了他将理论知识应用于实际问题的能力，为当时的社会经济发展做出了重要贡献。
points.descriptionEn: During his tenure in Danyang, Zu Chongzhi applied his mathematical and astronomical knowledge to practical engineering projects. He supervised the construction of various water conservancy projects, including improving irrigation systems and building dams. Using mathematical calculations for precise terrain and water flow measurements, he designed efficient water facilities that significantly improved agricultural productivity. Concurrently, he studied mechanical engineering and invented practical devices such as the south-pointing chariot and the 'thousand-li boat'. These engineering projects not only demonstrated his scientific abilities but also showcased his capacity to apply theoretical knowledge to practical problems, making significant contributions to the socioeconomic development of the time.

points.title: 晚年著述与传承
points.description: 晚年回到建康后，祖冲之专注于著述和学术传承。他完成了《大明历》的最终修订，并撰写了多部科学著作，包括《缀术》、《九章算术注》等。他还培养了一批学生，将自己的知识和方法传授给后人。在这一时期，他继续进行天文观测和数学研究，不断完善自己的理论体系。祖冲之的晚年虽然政治上不如意，但他在科学上的成就达到了顶峰，为中国古代科技发展做出了不可磨灭的贡献。他的著作和方法被后世学者广泛传承，影响了中国乃至世界科学的发展进程。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years after returning to Jiankang, Zu Chongzhi focused on writing and academic传承. He completed the final revisions of the 'Daming Calendar' and authored several scientific works, including 'Zhui Shu' and 'Commentary on Jiu Zhang Suan Shu'. He also taught numerous students, passing on his knowledge and methods to future generations. During this period, he continued astronomical observations and mathematical research, constantly refining his theoretical systems. Although politically unsuccessful in his later years, Zu Chongzhi's scientific achievements reached their pinnacle, making indelible contributions to ancient Chinese science and technology. His works and methods were widely passed down by later scholars, influencing the development of science in China and beyond.

supporter.zh: 祖冲之是中国古代最杰出的科学家之一，他在数学、天文学和工程学领域取得了举世瞩目的成就。他精确计算圆周率到小数点后七位，领先世界近千年；编制的《大明历》首次引入岁差概念，大大提高了历法准确性；他在水利工程和机械制造方面的实践，体现了理论联系实际的科学精神。祖冲之不仅是中国古代科技发展的杰出代表，也是世界科学史上的重要人物，他的成就彰显了中国古代科学的辉煌成就。
supporter.en: Zu Chongzhi stands as one of China's most outstanding ancient scientists, achieving remarkable accomplishments in mathematics, astronomy, and engineering. His calculation of pi to seven decimal places remained ahead of the world for nearly a millennium; the 'Daming Calendar' he created was the first to incorporate the precession of the equinoxes, significantly improving calendar accuracy; his practical work in water conservancy and machinery demonstrated the scientific spirit of connecting theory with practice. Not only a representative of ancient Chinese scientific development, Zu Chongzhi is also a significant figure in the history of world science, with his achievements highlighting the magnificent accomplishments of ancient Chinese science.

critic.zh: 从现代科学视角看，祖冲之的研究方法仍存在局限性。他的数学成果虽然精确，但缺乏系统的理论框架和公理化基础；天文观测虽有创新，但受限于当时的观测工具和理论水平；工程实践虽有成效，但未能形成系统的科学方法论。此外，他的科学成就主要服务于朝廷和农业生产，缺乏对基础科学理论的深入探索。这些局限反映了古代中国科学的特点：实用性强而理论体系不够完善，这也是中国古代科技未能产生近代科学革命的原因之一。
critic.en: From a modern scientific perspective, Zu Chongzhi's research methods had certain limitations. Although his mathematical achievements were precise, they lacked systematic theoretical frameworks and axiomatic foundations; his astronomical observations, while innovative, were constrained by contemporary observational tools and theoretical levels; his engineering practices, though effective, failed to develop systematic scientific methodologies. Additionally, his scientific achievements primarily served the imperial court and agricultural production, lacking in-depth exploration of fundamental scientific theories. These limitations reflect characteristics of ancient Chinese science: strong practical orientation but incomplete theoretical systems, which is one reason why ancient Chinese science did not lead to a scientific revolution.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，祖冲之被视为中国古代科技发展的巅峰人物之一。他的成就不仅体现了中国古代科学的辉煌，也反映了当时社会对科学的需求和支持。在流行文化中，祖冲之常被塑造成智慧与勤奋的象征，他的圆周率计算被视为中国古代数学的骄傲。然而，学术界也认识到，祖冲之的成就虽然卓越，但未能在中国形成持续的科学传统，这与中国古代社会的整体结构和价值取向有关。总体而言，祖冲之是中国科学史上的一座丰碑，他的贡献超越了时代，对后世产生了深远影响。
objective.en: In historical scholarship, Zu Chongzhi is regarded as one of the pinnacle figures in ancient Chinese scientific development. His achievements not only reflect the brilliance of ancient Chinese science but also demonstrate the societal demand for and support of science during his time. In popular culture, he is often portrayed as a symbol of wisdom and diligence, with his pi calculation celebrated as a source of pride in ancient Chinese mathematics. However, academia also recognizes that while his achievements were remarkable, they did not lead to a sustained scientific tradition in China, related to the overall structure and value orientation of ancient Chinese society. Overall, Zu Chongzhi stands as a monumental figure in Chinese scientific history, whose contributions transcended his time and had profound influence on later generations.

self.zh: 夫历法之难，莫大于岁差。
self.en: The difficulty of calendrical science lies most in the precession of the equinoxes.

others.zh: 祖冲之的圆周率计算，是中国古代数学的骄傲，也是世界数学史上的光辉一页。
others.en: Zu Chongzhi's calculation of pi is a source of pride in ancient Chinese mathematics and a brilliant page in the history of world mathematics.
